title: psoralea parviflora
intro: Psoralea parviflora, commonly known as Indian turnip or smallflower psoralea, is a plant species within the legume family. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to improve fertility and enhance bone density. The therapeutic actions of Psoralea parviflora are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, improve skin health, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include coumarins, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
